checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: audit range 1->39 state-machine lifecycle, history/clipboard cleanup; map restore collisions to a 400

impact_assessment.why: State-machine restore raises FileExistsError when the original name is occupied, and editor_action only maps KeyError/TypeError/ValueError, so clients receive a 500 for a normal collision.
impact_assessment.benefits: Restore collisions become actionable client errors instead of server failures.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: state-machine restore failure path; dependency: library_trash collision check; concurrency: session lock unchanged; state: trash/live files.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Catch FileExistsError in the action, add a collision regression, and run the 6/6 gate.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Map state-machine restore collisions to HTTP 400 with a rename/delete fix; regression covers save-delete-save-restore
[3/3] Range 1->39 gate passes 6/6 with actionable restore collisions; checklists: passed

handoff.next: commit and push range 1->39, then continue at 1->42

checkpoints.description: Task 'keystone-commit-audit-v3-1to39' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: audit range 1->42 clipboard, layer and registry reload fixes; reject missing same-name state-machine rename

impact_assessment.why: StateMachineLibrary.rename returns an error entry when source and target are the same missing name instead of raising KeyError, so the editor silently succeeds on a missing machine.
impact_assessment.benefits: Same-name rename now has the same missing-entry behavior as every other library operation.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: rename failure path; dependency: .kstate files; concurrency: session lock unchanged; state: no file changes.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Check source existence before the same-name shortcut, add a library regression, and run the 6/6 gate.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Reject same-name rename of a missing .kstate machine with KeyError; regression covers the shortcut
[3/3] Range 1->42 gate passes 6/6 with consistent missing state-machine rename; checklists: passed

handoff.next: commit and push range 1->42, then continue at 1->45

checkpoints.description: Task 'keystone-commit-audit-v3-1to42' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: audit range 1->45 prefab ordering, locked descendants and override rollback; block prefab revert when a descendant is locked

impact_assessment.why: revert_prefab checks only the selected instance root, then replaces the whole group, deleting a locked child. This bypasses the subtree deletion protection already applied to delete actions.
impact_assessment.benefits: Prefab revert honors locks on any node in the replaced group.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: revert failure path; dependency: subtree lock helper; concurrency: session lock unchanged; state: scene group replacement.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use the subtree lock check in revert_prefab, add a locked-child regression, and run the 6/6 gate.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Use subtree lock checks for prefab revert; regression locks a child and asserts the parent revert is rejected
[3/3] Range 1->45 gate passes 6/6 with locked-descendant prefab revert; checklists: passed

handoff.next: commit and push range 1->45, then finish the End range

checkpoints.description: Task 'keystone-commit-audit-v3-1to45' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: audit the final End range; block prefab apply when a locked descendant would be baked into the template

impact_assessment.why: revert now protects locked descendants, but apply_prefab still checks only the instance root before capturing the whole group into the prefab library, so a locked child can be overwritten into the template.
impact_assessment.benefits: Prefab apply respects the same subtree lock contract as delete, refresh and revert.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: apply failure path; dependency: subtree lock helper; concurrency: session lock unchanged; state: prefab template/library writes.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use the subtree lock check in apply_prefab, add a locked-child regression, and run the 6/6 gate.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Use subtree lock checks for prefab apply; regression locks a child and asserts applying its parent is rejected
[3/3] Final End range gate passes 6/6 with locked-descendant apply protection; checklists: passed

handoff.next: commit and push the End range

checkpoints.description: Task 'keystone-commit-audit-v3-end' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: add deterministic 1D animation blend spaces with JSON round trips and reports

impact_assessment.why: The animation stack has clips, crossfades and state machines but no blend space, so speed/direction-driven locomotion still requires game-side pose code.
impact_assessment.benefits: Games and AI tools get a reusable 1D blend primitive that samples and blends clips deterministically, with schema-1 JSON and a report.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive animation API; dependency: existing AnimationClip/blend_poses; concurrency: none; state: immutable blend spaces.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate threshold ordering, finite values and clip shapes; add unit tests for interpolation, clamping, serialization and errors; run the 6/6 gate.

handoff.state: core API, exports and tests green
